Name: Barbie's Sam Hair Mod
Author: BarbiePop
Description:
Hello!

As a fan of Sam and his mullet, my goal was to make a portrait pack that matches the vanilla style but just makes some tweaks. The files in this can be used to replace Sam's original portraits as well as his Joja outfit and beach look. I may make one for winter, however I am not in the process of making one right now. This is my first mod so please be patient with me as I am learning. I hope people like these and enjoy his new look ^^

____________________________________________________

[font=Verdana]Instructions for how to use[/font][font=Verdana]
[/font]
1.Download files from Nexus
2. Unzip/extract the file.
3. Add to your Stardew Valley mods folder
4.Start the game and enjoy!
